newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sumitomo Chemical to build Singapore plants.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Chemical to build Singapore plants.

text.p: Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd and three Japanese companies have started construction on six plants to produce acrylic acid and its derivatives in Singapore, the company said on Tuesday.
Sumitomo said the plants, to be built at a cost of about US$300 million, are the first of its kind in Singapore for production of methyl methacrylate (MMA), acrylic acid and its derivatives.

Sumitomo's partner in the various plants are Toagosei Asia Pte Ltd to build a crude acrylic acid and an acrylic ester plant, Sumitomo Seika to produce super absorbent polymer and an MMA monomer plant with Nippon Shokubai.
Separately, the company will build a glacial acrylic acid plant, and an MMA polymer plant.
The plants are scheduled to start up in July 1998.
These plants produce plastics and other chemical products that are used to make diapers, adhesives and coatings for electronic products.
